Title: Password visibility icon state is inconsistent
Steps to Reproduce: Enter password and compare visibility icons in Password and Confirm Password fields
Actual Result: Icon state does not match actual password visibility
Expected Result: Open-eye state should mean visible; closed-eye state should mean hidden

Title: Incorrect error message for invalid password
Steps to Reproduce: Sign in with valid email and incorrect password
Actual Result: Message indicates that the email is not registered
Expected Result: Message should identify invalid password or invalid credentials

Title: Application from unpublished veteran profile is not visible to recruiter
Steps to Reproduce: Submit application and check recruiter applications
Actual Result: Application exists/status changes but recruiter cannot see it until profile publication
Expected Result: Behavior should match defined business rule and provide clear user feedback

Title: User with incomplete profile can submit job application
Preconditions: Veteran is authenticated with incomplete profile
Steps to Reproduce: Open a vacancy and submit application
Actual Result: Application can be submitted before required profile completion
Expected Result: System should prevent submission or clearly require completion of required profile data

Title: No first-login onboarding guidance for veteran
Steps to Reproduce: Complete registration and observe first screen
Actual Result: User is redirected without welcome/profile-completion guidance
Expected Result: Show onboarding guidance and a clear action to complete profile

Title: Veteran phone field validation issue
Steps to Reproduce: Enter invalid phone values
Actual Result: Field accepts invalid values / validation behavior is unclear
Expected Result: Phone input should enforce the documented format and show a clear validation error

Title: Vacancy activation shows creation date instead of publication date
Steps to Reproduce: Activate/publish vacancy and inspect displayed date
Actual Result: Creation date is shown where publication date is expected
Expected Result: Display the correct publication/activation date

Title: Incorrect surname display in recruiter application list
Steps to Reproduce: Open vacancy applications and compare applicant data with profile
Actual Result: Surname is displayed incorrectly
Expected Result: Stored applicant name/surname should be displayed correctly

Title: Phone field accepts invalid values
Preconditions: Form with phone field is open
Steps to Reproduce: Enter spaces, letters, symbols, wrong country format and submit
Actual Result: Invalid values are accepted/saved
Expected Result: Reject invalid values, block submission and show clear error

Title: Company vacancy link lacks clear visual affordance
Steps to Reproduce: Locate and hover 'All company vacancies'
Actual Result: Link looks like normal text; only cursor changes
Expected Result: Use recognizable link styling or hover treatment

Title: Empty white block appears below footer
Steps to Reproduce: Open page and scroll below footer
Actual Result: Extra empty white area is displayed
Expected Result: Page should end cleanly without unintended empty block

Title: No validation message for empty email field
Steps to Reproduce: Leave email empty and move focus/submit
Actual Result: No clear error message is displayed
Expected Result: Required email field should show a clear validation message

Title: Email placeholder does not provide sufficient guidance
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect email field placeholder
Actual Result: Placeholder does not provide useful format guidance
Expected Result: Provide concise example/format guidance if required by UX specification

Title: Registration form accepts invalid values
Steps to Reproduce: Enter invalid values in registration fields
Actual Result: Invalid values can be accepted without adequate validation
Expected Result: Invalid values should be rejected with clear field-level feedback

Title: Password validation error message is missing/incomplete
Steps to Reproduce: Enter invalid password
Actual Result: Validation error is missing or insufficient
Expected Result: Display password requirements and block invalid submission

Title: CTA buttons have incorrect role-dependent active states
Preconditions: User can be logged out, recruiter or veteran
Steps to Reproduce: Open home page and inspect role-specific CTAs
Actual Result: Buttons can remain active/highlighted regardless of role
Expected Result: CTA state should correspond to current authentication/role state

Title: Veteran job-posting CTA block is incorrectly positioned
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect hero/CTA layout
Actual Result: CTA block is positioned inconsistently with intended layout
Expected Result: Place the block according to the approved page layout

Title: Veteran login redirects inconsistently
Steps to Reproduce: Sign in repeatedly and observe destination
Actual Result: User can land on Home instead of the Veteran dashboard
Expected Result: Authenticated veteran should be routed consistently to the intended destination

Title: Duplicate navigation actions on Veteran dashboard
Steps to Reproduce: Open Veteran dashboard
Actual Result: The same destination/action is exposed more than once
Expected Result: Each primary action should be represented once or clearly differentiated

Title: My Applications navigation requires link/route verification
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect My Applications element and follow it
Actual Result: Navigation/route behavior requires verification
Expected Result: Button should navigate to the intended My Applications page consistently

Title: Phone field accepts invalid values on veteran profile setup
Steps to Reproduce: Enter invalid phone values
Actual Result: Invalid values are accepted
Expected Result: Apply consistent phone validation on profile setup

Title: No limit/handling for a large number of profile skills
Steps to Reproduce: Add many skills
Actual Result: UI/validation does not define or enforce a reasonable skill limit
Expected Result: Define and handle the allowed number of skills according to product requirements

Title: UI reports jobs found while the result list is empty
Steps to Reproduce: Run the relevant search and compare UI count with returned list/DevTools response
Actual Result: UI can show a positive result count while no job cards are rendered
Expected Result: Displayed count and rendered results should remain consistent
